purpose: Route an installed fleet through the current PowerShell operator when the optional CMD shim is absent or blocked, without duplicating adapter/provider readiness logic.
preconditions: boundary classification is installed-unclassified or cmd-shim-blocked
pwsh is available on the observed workstation

steps.action: Preserve any supplied CMD-shim outcome as boundary evidence. Do not retry the shim after Access is denied / exit 5.
Invoke the installed Start-AgentSwitchboard.ps1 with -ListAgents through pwsh.
steps.success: exit code 0; output is local fleet readiness evidence only

steps.action: Generate the current canonical startup-readiness report.
Use current startup-readiness statuses for adapter/provider decisions; this workflow does not reinterpret them.

forbidden: rerun setup solely because the CMD compatibility shim is missing or blocked
retry agent-switchboard.cmd after Access is denied / exit 5
claim provider authentication or hosted response from -ListAgents
install or repair Hermes as part of this compatibility-boundary workflow
create a second fleet launcher or readiness lifecycle
proofCeiling: An observed run can prove the installed PowerShell operator executed and emitted current local readiness. It still does not prove provider authentication, exact model availability, quota, hosted response, repository delivery, or task completion.
